science_goal: learn raw public one-bit mismatch event masks through strong FIT-only bit-lane supervision, then learn a trainable relational binder from FIT examples; no explicit mismatch-index/equality operator in neural inference

source.independent_generator: new layered braided 3-way distracting graph source; no import or invocation of F124AJ / earlier cohort builders

architecture.local_operator: shared 2-bit->8 tanh->1 sigmoid MLP trained to predict actual public carried-vs-src bit flip for each bit lane (FIT-only intermediate edge supervision). No explicit XOR/mismatch index in inference; 4 raw input pair types are cached from learned network once per graph for bounded CPU.
architecture.first_event_memory: pack learned 16-lane binary flip mask with sentinel into EXISTING cell.score scalar, no new persistent cell fields. Learned mask from sigmoid >=0.5 per raw lane. Lanes aligned by engineered public bit order.
architecture.event_gate: Require exactly one learned flip bit on two separate edges and zero elsewhere; this event-count policy is engineered and must not be reported as learned.
architecture.trainable_relation: FIT-labelled examples supervise a sigmoid logistic binder on aggregated aligned binary pair histogram (00,01,10,11), four learned histogram weights+one bias; no supplied bit-index equality rule or oracle at inference.

training.intermediate_label: public FIT edge carried/raw16 src per-lane difference labels from training-only public true pathway; no labels provided during inference
training.balanced_four_pattern_training: each of 00,01,10,11 FIT-present; equal-weight per-pattern batch gradient, no hand-coded XOR feature at inference
training.head_input: histogram of four learned mask lane-pairs over 16 aligned lanes; head weights+offset learned from FIT
training.threshold_selection: maximize FIT correctly paired with ZERO FIT false positives and at least 72/144 FIT positive recalls; else no-qualified threshold, use fixed 0.1 solely for diagnostic DEV; never use DEV for tuning

attribution: report local hop-accuracy 4 raw patterns plus held-out public FIT-labelled bit scores; binder training delta and ablation vs untrained head, learned vs perfect deterministic controls; do not claim learned superiority if deterministic same accuracy
